reader_summary.overview: Hello, everyone, welcome back to the A16Z podcast. Today, we've got a special episode covering a timely piece of news that, quite frankly, I wish we were not reporting on. In case you missed it, this week, there was a reported breach of nearly 3 billion records, but not just any records.

key_points.text: Headlines included, quote, billions of social security numbers exposed, or even, quote, did hackers steal every social security number?
